# s2kt7_seed5 — regenerated s2kt7 data (base seed 5)

Same regeneration as `../s2kt7_seed1` (fixes the seed-0 degeneracy where every click
dropped food at (0,0); see `../s2kt7/` and memory seed0-degenerate-data-gen), but with
**base seed 5**. Generated by `prototypes/perc_invdyn/gen_s2kt7_seed1.py --base-seed 5`.

Per-episode interpreter seeds (base 5 + disjoint per-split offsets): train 105-112,
test 305-306, test50 505-512. 8 / 2 / 8 episodes, 14 steps each, whitelist `noop,click`.
Real foraging: clicks spawn 2 food at random cells; ants step toward nearest food and eat.
Episodes are full trajectories (K-step context inline). See dynamics.txt for true mechanics.
